mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 1.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances economic growth prospects, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of non-recessionary periods with positive INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling housing market strength, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it indicates robust consumer demand.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of positive HOUST growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating rising inflation expectations, and FEDFUNDS is below 1%, investors anticipate monetary policy adjustments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 5%, coupled with a RSAFS increase above $400,000, signaling strong labor market and consumer spending, positively affects S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.055 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved supply chain efficiency, enhances economic growth prospects, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during periods of low UNRATE (below 7%).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of low-unemployment periods with positive INDPRO growth, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2.5-year rolling window.
